question: Should OpenClaw add agent-scoped web/tool credential overrides, and should the permanent surface be agents.list[].tools.web, plugin-owned per-agent config, or a unified credential model?
rationale: The request changes security-sensitive credential isolation and config precedence across core, plugins, legacy tools.web, SecretRefs, docs, and upgrade behavior, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Choose a unified credential contract
options.body: Define one agent-scoped credential/config model that web search and plugin-owned config can share without competing sources of truth.

options.title: Fold into per-agent plugin config
options.body: Treat #55401 as the canonical design and require it to explicitly cover the web-search API-key/provider use case before closing this issue.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Document separate gateway instances or existing per-agent model defaults as the supported alternative and close the related tool/plugin override requests together.

recommendation.title: Choose a unified credential contract
recommendation.body: Define one agent-scoped credential/config model that web search and plugin-owned config can share without competing sources of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner signal for the config/security/plugin-boundary decision from recent adjacent history.
